Tara (CS): Heads-up: Peregrine Labs wants to add two new squads next month (Search infra + Personalization). They called out session-scoped embeddings, realtime scoring, and nightly bulk imports. Asking for an ops checklist and sizing.
Mikko (AM): Great expansion signal. Any rough qps/throughput numbers? helps decide Dedicated vs hosted.
Tara (CS): Their doc: Search ~350 rps peak, Personalization ~140 rps, nightly ingest ~120k docs. Multi-region (us-east + eu-west) is a concern.
Renee (Eng): 350 rps + multi-region = recommend Dedicated pilot with regional pools + KV cache. Quick sketch:
```search peak: 350 rps
personalization: 140 rps
batch: 120k docs/night
SLOs: p50 < 25ms, p95 < 140ms```
Sam (Solutions): Model plan: quality path for personalization (rdx-4-ptq) and faster quantized route for search. Recommend canary 5-10% with checks on latency, 5xx, and token-cost-delta.
Tara (CS): Actions: 1) one-pager (config + month-1 cost delta) 2) onboarding playbook (kickoff, creds, canary) 3) runbook snippets for KV warmup and rollback. @Mikko you own pricing.
Mikko (AM): On it 3 will include payg vs 3mo commit and a renewal upsell angle. Watch for cost pushback during review.
Renee (Eng): Short config snippet to share: model: rdx-4-ptq / rdx-embed-small-quant; batching: adaptive; kv_cache: prefix+session_id; autoscale: min:2 max:8; warmup: prefill-kv-cache=true.
jenkins-bot: ticket created "peregrine-regional-dedicated-proposal" assigned to @Mikko @Renee @Sam due_in: 3 business days.
Tara (CS): No churn signals. Primary risks: tail latency and cross-region egress. We'll include Optimize suggestions: prefix caching, KV TTL tuning, and batched embed windows.
Mikko (AM): I'll post pricing draft here when ready.
Sam (Solutions): Playbook draft ETA 48hrs.
Tara (CS): Scheduling kickoff with their infra team for next Tue. Drop blockers here. Thanks all :handshake:
